resources.string: All fields are required. Enter unsigned decimal numbers. Target device 0 matches any device. Drafts remain available when you reopen this dialog on this screen.
Enter a whole decimal number from 0 to 18446744073709551615.
Enter an encoded device number from 0 to 4294967295.

Numeric rules apply to the running kernel only and are removed by a reboot or clearing runtime rules. For the same inode/device, numeric rules take priority over saved path rules. Saved path rules are restored on apply or boot when Maps spoofing is enabled.
Enter an absolute path beginning with /.
Remove line breaks and control characters from the path.
Shorten the path to at most 255 UTF-8 bytes.
